services.name: Waterproofing

leader.cta_line: Most leaks here are not in the middle of the roof. They are at a parapet, a box gutter or a balcony edge that was never detailed properly.

services.intro_body:
Waterproofing in Cape Town starts with finding where water enters, not where the stain appears. The north-westerly front pushes rain sideways across roofs and under tiles, so most leaks sit at a junction, not mid-roof.

It fails in two ways: the membrane reaches the end of its life, which is predictable, or the detail was wrong from the start. No primer, a fall running back towards the wall, a flashing sealed with silicone instead of metal. We read moisture through the plaster, hose test where needed, and specify for the substrate.

services.name: Roof Waterproofing

leader.cta_line: A roof does not fail all at once. It fails at one flashing, one upstand, one box gutter that nobody cleaned.

services.intro_body:
Roof waterproofing in Cape Town is a specification decision before it is a labour one. The same house can need a torch-on membrane on a flat concrete slab, an acrylic coating on fibre cement, and lead flashings at the chimney, because each surface behaves differently in sideways rain.

We identify the roof type and pitch, then choose a system that suits both. Flat roofs need fall correction before membrane; tile and slate roofs need flashings at valleys, not a coating over the tiles.

services.name: Roof Repairs

leader.cta_line: Storm damage, a lifted flashing, a cracked tile. Fix the cause before the ceiling pays for it.

services.intro_heading: What a roof repair is for
services.intro_body:
Roof repairs in Cape Town cover the damage that waterproofing cannot: tiles lifted by north-westerly wind, flashings torn at a gable, a valley blocked with debris, a sheet that pulled its fasteners. These are fixing jobs, not coating jobs.

We separate repair from replacement honestly. A ridge with three cracked tiles is a repair. A roof at the end of its life with fasteners rusted through is not, and recoating it only postpones the conversation by a winter.

services.name: Leaking Ceiling Repair

leader.cta_line: A brown ring on the ceiling is the end of the story. The leak started somewhere else, days or months earlier.

services.intro_heading: Fix a leak in the ceiling
services.intro_body:
Leaking ceiling repair begins above the ceiling, not on it. Water travels along a joist, a truss or a sheet before it drops, so the stain is usually not under the entry point. Paint hides the evidence while damage continues into insulation and plasterboard.

We find the source first: roof, flashing, valley, geyser, plumbing or a balcony above. Then we repair it, replace soft board and treat the stain so it does not bleed through new paint.

services.name: Painting

leader.cta_line: Paint fails on preparation, not on the tin. We fix the surface before the colour goes on.

services.intro_heading: Painting that lasts a Cape winter
services.intro_body:
Painters in Cape Town work on walls that take rain sideways and sun the rest of the year. Exterior paint fails early when the surface was not prepared: chalky plaster, damp patches, old gloss not keyed, cracks filled with the wrong filler.

We prepare first, repair what is failing, treat damp before painting over it, and use a coating system matched to the surface. Interior work is sequenced around a lived-in house, with rooms returned to use the same day where possible.

services.name: Plastering

leader.cta_line: Blown plaster is a symptom. Paint over it and it comes back with the next damp spell.

services.intro_body:
Plastering in Cape Town means two different jobs: new plaster on a wall or ceiling, and repairing plaster that has failed. The second is more common. Hollow, blown or salt-damaged plaster usually has moisture behind it, and covering it only buys a season.

We cut back to sound material, treat the cause, then plaster to match the existing finish. Skim coats, crack repair, cornices and stucco Italiano are all done by the same team, which matters when the finish has to line up with a wall done twenty years ago.

services.name: Tiling

leader.cta_line: Tiles fail at the substrate, not the tile. Level, dry and waterproof underneath is the whole job.

services.intro_heading: Tiling floors, walls and wet areas
services.intro_body:
Tiling in Cape Town is mostly about what happens before the first tile is laid: screeding to a level, waterproofing a shower correctly, priming a surface that will take adhesive. Tiles laid on an uneven or wet substrate crack, lift or sound hollow within a year.

We screed, waterproof and tile with the same team, so nobody is blaming the previous trade. That matters most in bathrooms, where the waterproofing, the fall and the tile lines all have to agree.
